reuse.why: Fintegra goes through withBankAccountLinkCheck, findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and getServer, and the new linkBankSyncAccount/downloadBankSyncTransactions helpers serve every existing provider too.

duplication.why: Instead of a sixth copy of the link function and a third copy of the token-post-transactions download, it folds the existing copies into one helper each.

placement.why: Linking stays in accounts/app.ts, downloading in accounts/sync.ts, the base path in server-config.ts and the type in types/models, the same places the other providers use.

scope.why: Rewrites the GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking linkers and the Akahu/Pluggy downloaders, which the request did not ask for, and changes small behaviours on the way (fileId now passed for every provider, Akahu now notifies the accounts table, official_name/mask defaults).

maintainability.why: One link path and one download path are much easier to own, but the unrequested refactor's behaviour changes to existing providers would need separate review.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing link-check wrapper, bank lookup and sync entry point.

disguised_duplication.where: Copies are actually removed and shared, not reshaped; only the akahu/fintegra balance branch is widened with an OR.
